payload.title: Two of the five G1 fields, learning_log_live (a bool) and mechanisms_contributing (an int), can never be None, and mechanism_scorecard reads a missing or unbound learning journal as an empty one, so a store with no learning instrument counts as 'measured' in every cycle of the G1 run
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/autonomy_evidence.py:4692-4698 (an unbound store or an absent journal file becomes an empty row list)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/autonomy_evidence.py:4703-4710 (live is a bool and mechanisms_contributing an int)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/autonomy_evidence.py:4750 (a field is measured when its value is not None)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/data/genesis_policy_default.json:98-99 (both names are in the pre-registered G1 list)
aria-kernel/tests/test_scorecard_mechanisms.py:114-118 (the test pins 'no journal = dormant' as the reading)
payload.rule_violated: ARIA-MEDIUM-733 / ARIA-LOW-732 intent: a dormant learner must read differently from a working one and a field with no producer reads unmeasured with a named reason, never a silent zero.
payload.notes: On an empty store, or one whose journal path cannot be resolved, mechanism_scorecard returns live False, mechanisms_contributing 0 and all five mechanisms as quarantine candidates once 30 cycles are supplied. g1_gap_free_run treats False and 0 as measured, so 14 cycles of a dead learning loop satisfy the learning half of G1; an absent instrument and a dormant one are the same reading. Close condition: Return None for both fields when the journal surface cannot be read (unbound store, absent file) and keep 0 and False only for a readable empty journal, then update the test that pins missing = dormant; a test asserts g1_gap_free_run reports learning_log_live as none for an unbound store. Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
